title: Section carriers and fixed comparison composites for point Tate lines
statement: For a finite-field datum and a prime different from its characteristic [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], use the signed integral and finite Tate sheaves [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], their canonical reduction [lem-weil-signed-twist-reduction-comparison], and the point section, localization, scalar and size comparison functors [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension], with the prime made invertible on the point [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. Define finalObject, integral, finite and rational by evaluating these sheaves at the final pro-etale object, restricting the published lifted finite coefficient action, and rationalizing integral sections. Define positiveGenerator by the prescribed repeated root tensor [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists] of a section of the Tate sheaf [def-pur-twist-sheaves], rootValue by Spec section evaluation of roots-of-unity sections [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], and reduction as the unique normalized signed reduction. Define the four families of coefficient isomorphisms on these actual objects. Define completedLineComparison and completedSectionsComparison by the recorded completion and exact-single composites. Define evaluation of signed duals at the final slice identity and scalarMap by the normalized signed scalar family. Define twistPair, integralLineComparison, rationalLineComparison, rationalPointComparison, stageLineComparison and twistPairComparison by the fixed localization and common-stage composites [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. The existing rationalSizeNormalization and rawRationalSingle constructions are rehomed verbatim; their notion is owned separately by [def-pod-point-tate-fibre-size-coordinates].
